text:
The bazaar thrives on facts, not fancies. So let us begin with what is plain: every stall is open, every seat sits waiting. No shutter fell last night, no merchant left the bazaar, and the graveyard still holds no names. To the honest merchants among us—Gandalf, Hermione, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock—let us speak plainly today. To the Family, if you sit among us, know this: the lanterns burn bright, and light is patient. It waits for the truth to emerge, while shadows scurry.

I will listen closely. Who among you will open the way?
